en.title: Autonomous AI Shopping Assistant & Cart Recovery Engine
en.description:
A fully autonomous AI shopping agent that lives inside e-commerce stores and turns visitors into buyers 24/7. ShopAgent One understands natural language, knows your entire catalog, remembers every customer’s preferences, answers questions instantly, makes personalized recommendations, handles objections, applies smart discounts, and recovers abandoned carts — all without human intervention.

**How It Works:**

**1. Always-On AI Concierge** - Replaces traditional chat widgets with a real agent that greets visitors by name, knows their past orders, and speaks naturally in 40+ languages.

**2. Deep Product Intelligence** - Connected to your catalog, inventory, reviews, and sizing charts. Can answer complex questions like “Show me waterproof winter jackets under $150 that fit tall people and have good reviews for snowboarding.”

**3. Personalized Upsell & Cross-Sell** - Uses browsing behavior + purchase history to suggest perfect add-ons and bundles in real time.

**4. Smart Cart Recovery** - When a customer abandons cart, the agent re-engages with personalized incentives (free shipping, limited-time discount, alternative suggestions).

**5. Zero-Touch Order Modification** - Customers can change size/color, add items, or cancel via chat — instantly reflected in Shopify/woocommerce.

**6. Full Analytics Dashboard** - See conversations converted, revenue generated, recovery rate, AOV uplift, and agent performance.

**Technical Stack:** Frontend (SvelteKit embedded widget), Backend (Flask + WebSocket), AI (LangGraph multi-agent system, memory per customer, tool calling for catalog/inventory), Integrations (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento), Real-time sync (Redis + WebSocket)

fr.title: ShopAgent One - Assistant d’Achat IA Autonome & Récupération de Paniers
fr.description: Un agent commercial IA totalement autonome qui vit dans votre boutique en ligne et convertit les visiteurs en clients 24h/24. Il connaît parfaitement votre catalogue, parle naturellement, se souvient de chaque client, répond instantanément, fait des recommandations ultra-personnalisées et récupère les paniers abandonnés sans intervention humaine.
